categories.main_business_segments: Foshan Blue Rocket Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in semiconductor packaging and testing services. The company provides discrete devices and integrated circuit products, including diodes, transistors, MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC and GaN power semiconductors, as well as integrated circuits such as LDO, AC-DC, DC-DC converters, lithium battery protection ICs, charging management ICs, and LED driver ICs. It operates both self-branded product sales and packaging and testing services for IDM and fabless semiconductor companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in metal substrate packaging, fully integrated lithium battery protection ICs, system-in-package (SIP), flip chip (FC) technology, copper bridge packaging, ultra-thin chip packaging, and high-reliability welding. It has developed advanced packaging processes including no-frame packaging, high-density etched frame packaging, clip bond technology for high current and low thermal resistance, and digitalized, intelligent, and automated production systems. The company covers full-process packaging and testing capabilities from 4-inch to 12-inch wafers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor industry players such as IDM and fabless companies, as well as downstream sectors like consumer electronics, home appliances, power supplies, automotive electronics, network communications, security electronics, and emerging fields like 5G communication base stations, new energy vehicles, and industrial automation. Major customers include well-known semiconductor firms and large appliance manufacturers like Midea and Gree, as well as international clients such as Samsung Electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong presence in the South China region, including Guangdong Province where its headquarters and main production base are located. It also serves customers across other Chinese regions such as East China, Northwest, and Southwest China. The company is actively expanding its overseas market presence to diversify geographic revenue sources.
categories.supply_chain_position: Blue Rocket Electronics operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on semiconductor packaging and testing services. It acts as a key link between wafer fabrication and downstream semiconductor device assembly and end-product manufacturing, providing packaging and testing solutions for chips sourced from upstream wafer fabs or fabless design companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in semiconductor packaging technologies, focusing on miniaturization, integration, low power consumption, and advanced packaging platforms such as SIP, flip chip, and wide bandgap semiconductor packaging (SiC, GaN). It invests heavily in R&D, collaborating with universities and research institutes, and expanding its patent portfolio. Strategic priorities include developing automotive-grade power devices, high-density packaging, and digital and analog IC packaging to enhance competitiveness and market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through two main channels: sales of self-branded semiconductor products (packaged and tested chips) and provision of packaging and testing services for customer-provided chips. The company charges fees for packaging and testing services and sells finished semiconductor devices under its own brand to various end markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic semiconductor packaging and testing firms such as Jiangsu Changjiang Electronics Technology (JCET), Tianshui Huatian Technology, and Tongfu Microelectronics. While Blue Rocket Electronics has a strong regional presence and core technology advantages in metal substrate and system-in-package technologies, it faces competition from industry leaders with broader advanced packaging capabilities. The company positions itself as a specialized, innovative mid-tier player focusing on differentiated packaging solutions and emerging semiconductor markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 713 million, a slight decline of 3.19% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 15.1 million, down 74.11% year-over-year. Despite the profit decline, operating cash flow improved by over 50%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.87 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.53 billion. It is in a growth phase with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D, supported by recent IPO fundraising.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Blue Rocket Electronics offers high-performance, low-power, highly reliable semiconductor packaging and testing solutions with a broad product portfolio covering over 100 packaging series. Its unique value lies in advanced packaging technologies such as ultra-thin chip packaging, clip bond technology, and system-in-package integration, enabling high current capacity, superior thermal performance, and miniaturization. The company provides one-stop semiconductor device solutions tailored to customer needs, emphasizing quality, innovation, and comprehensive customer service to maintain competitive differentiation.
